neighbours.label: the second 0 of a 2000s year (200x) in a US-style date written with the weekday first (Weekday, Month Day, Year), e.g. a blog-post dateline; silent for 2010s years, dates with no weekday, day-first dates and bare years in prose; strength varies a lot with the particular day and month
neighbours.short: 200x year digit in weekday-first US dates
neighbours.notes: Polysemantic deep cell: other top examples are Arabic word starts (' الث', ' الس') and the first piece of a rare second name (Larrea tr-, Jorge Pos-); the label covers only the dateline facet (10 of the top 32 peaks are '0'). Probes showed strong day/month dependence (e.g. June 22 0.52 vs November 14 0.01). Feeders-first arm: strongest feeders L33/N10146- (the digit '1' in numbers like 10/16) and L17/N7220- (the space before a day number after a weekday). Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label only.
